cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)

project(globalProject)

 set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${CMAKE_MODULE_PATH} "${globalProject_SOURCE_DIR}/CMakeModules")
#################
## binary directory
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib)
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)

###################
## set compiler flags
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L ${USER_CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${USER_CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
add_definitions(-D ECOA_64BIT_SUPPORT)

set(CMAKE_USE_DDS_PROTO false CACHE BOOL "DDS protocol")
set(CMAKE_USE_UDP_PROTO false CACHE BOOL "UDP protocol")
# DDS Domain ID (0-232): injected from dds-binding.xml via -DCYCLONEDDS_DOMAIN_ID=N
set(CYCLONEDDS_DOMAIN_ID 0 CACHE STRING "CycloneDDS Domain ID (0-232)")
if(CMAKE_USE_DDS_PROTO)
    set(CMAKE_USE_UDP_PROTO false CACHE BOOL "UDP protocol" FORCE)
    message("-- Use DDS protocol (domain=${CYCLONEDDS_DOMAIN_ID})")
    add_definitions(-D USE_DDS_PROTO=1 -D USE_UDP_PROTO=0)
    add_definitions(-D LDP_DDS_DOMAIN_ID=${CYCLONEDDS_DOMAIN_ID})
elseif(CMAKE_USE_UDP_PROTO)
    message("-- Use UDP protocol")
    add_definitions(-D USE_DDS_PROTO=0 -D USE_UDP_PROTO=1)
else()
    message("-- Use TCP protocol")
    add_definitions(-D USE_DDS_PROTO=0 -D USE_UDP_PROTO=0)
endif ()

if(NOT CMAKE_USE_AF_UNIX)
    set(CMAKE_USE_AF_UNIX false)
    message("-- Use AF_INET socket family")
else()
    message("-- Use AF_UNIX socket family")
endif ()
add_definitions(-D USE_AF_UNIX=${CMAKE_USE_AF_UNIX})
find_package(PkgConfig)

#############
## APR
find_package ( APR )
if (APR_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "Find APR in ${APR_ROOT_PATH}")
    link_directories(${APR_LIB_DIR})
else(APR_FOUND)
    message(SEND_ERROR "No APR found")
endif (APR_FOUND)

if(${LDP_LOG_USE} STREQUAL "lttng")
   pkg_check_modules(lttng-ust REQUIRED lttng-ust)
elseif(${LDP_LOG_USE} STREQUAL "log4cplus")
   #############
   ## LOG4CPLUS
   find_package ( log4cplus REQUIRED )
elseif(${LDP_LOG_USE} STREQUAL "zlog")
   #############
   ## ZLOG
   find_package ( zlog REQUIRED )
endif()

#############
## PThread
set(THREADS_PREFER_PTHREAD_FLAG ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

##########
## libecoa
add_subdirectory(platform/lib)
add_subdirectory(platform/svc_deserial)
add_subdirectory(0-Types)

#################
## components and plarform executables
add_subdirectory(platform)
add_subdirectory(mycompXXXDevice)
if(${LDP_LOG_USE} STREQUAL "lttng")
add_custom_target(run
    COMMAND lttng create Session_ECOA\; lttng enable-event --userspace ldp_lttng_log:* \; lttng start \; ./platform \; STATUS_ECOA=$$? \; lttng stop \; lttng destroy Session_ECOA\;exit $$STATUS_ECOA
    DEPENDS platform PD_XXX_PD
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin
)
else()
add_custom_target(run
    COMMAND ./platform \; STATUS_ECOA=$$? \; python -c 
\"import os, datetime\;
os.rename\('${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/logs',
            '${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/logs-'+datetime.datetime.now\(\).strftime\('%Y%m%d%H%M%S'\)\)
 \" \; exit $$STATUS_ECOA
    DEPENDS platform PD_XXX_PD
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin
)
endif()

if (EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/local.cmake )
	include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/local.cmake)
endif (EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/local.cmake )
